run_mdx_refine_explorer: run the MDX Track A refined training grid explorer with SLURM launcher on 8 GPUs
launch_mdx_refine_experiments: launch MDX Track A experiments with quantization diffq values of 1e-4 and 3e-4
get_experiment_from_sig: get an experiment configuration object from its signature using main.get_xp_from_sig
create_experiment_from_argv: create an experiment instance from a list of argv arguments using main.get_xp
configure_slurm_launcher: configure the SLURM launcher with 8 GPUs, 72 hour time limit, and learnlab partition
